risks.risk_statement: Ambiguous ownership boundaries -> delayed incident mitigation during cross-team outages.
risks.mechanism: Unclear accountability can fragment escalation paths and slow urgent decision coordination.
evidence: Prior environments relied on informal handoffs instead of explicit escalation ownership.
counter_signals: Candidate describes successful use of rotating incident command responsibilities.
risks.validation_suggestion: Ask for a recent outage timeline and identify exact ownership transfer points.
risks.confidence_rationale: Signal appears plausible but depends on team process maturity details.

risks.risk_statement: Narrow domain transfer -> slower onboarding when system context shifts quickly.
risks.mechanism: Specialized experience may not map directly to unfamiliar architecture boundaries at startup speed.
evidence: Recent projects cluster around one platform with consistent service boundaries.
counter_signals: Candidate previously transitioned across two stacks within one quarter.
risks.validation_suggestion: Probe for a transition example requiring fast comprehension of unknown subsystems.
risks.confidence_rationale: Resume hints at both specialization and adaptation, so uncertainty remains high.
